notes: Synthetic record and node; gates rotate the early exits (node type, entry count, sign word, group test 0xcc22c). The eight callees log their inputs (byte and word inputs masked) and return the next dword of a shared queue whose low words are zero 30-70% of the time, so the three retry loops end at different points; the high words are random so the cleared result of 0xbd5f8 is checked in full. The limit in BX covers 0, 1, 0x7fff, 0x8000, 0xffff.
